description: Red (Taylor's Version) is mother reclaiming her masters and giving us the vault tracks we DESERVED 😭✨ The 10 minute All Too Well alone is worth five stars, but then 'Nothing New' with Phoebe Bridgers and 'I Bet You Think About Me'?? she said 'you want the lore? here's EVERYTHING'. It's the definitive version of Red and the re-recording era is her greatest flex. Iconic, no skips, the vault ate 💅🔥
